snippet.title: The Last Pixel // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/1182680/The_Last_Pixel/

Experience the world as The Last Pixel in existence as it travels through two different eras of classic gaming in an experimental 2D game inspired by Pong and Super Mario Bros. With over 10 levels to beat, this short but fun adventure will take you for a ride.

Developed by
spiregg

*Note* This game is no longer available on the Steam store
